pages.title: Absolute Dossier
pages.text: The research record of a civilisation that has very nearly finished understanding its universe. Its cover is primordial law itself, so the book reads like a document from before the universe decided its rules. It weighs exactly what I expect it to, which unsettles me more than anything.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)To build the Omnilex Engine I needed a machine that knew everything I did. I bound the three absolute volumes over the unified dossier with primordial law, and for the first time the Research Nexus had nothing left to ask me.
Made in $(item)Femtoscale Assembly Line$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): The Omnilex.
